text:
maya: Heads up — we need ND/NC GPU quota + capacity reservation in westeurope for the new training fleet.

maya: Details: subscription 6f3aXXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-9a1b2c3d4e5f, project tag=redwood-prod, requested start window next Tue.

maya: Requesting: Standard_ND40rs_v2 x6, Standard_NC24s_v3 x4. Also need NIC / vCPU soft limits checked (we've hit NIC quota on previous deploys).

sam: Thanks — I'll open an Azure support case now. Do we need guaranteed capacity (reservation) or just quota?

maya: We want a capacity reservation for the ND instances if possible (training jobs are latency-sensitive). Quota w/o reservation will be fallback.

sam: Ok creating SR with priority: Production. Will request capacity reservation for westeurope and a fallback quota in eastus2.

infra-bot: Creating support case...

infra-bot: /az-support create --sub 6f3aXXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-9a1b2c3d4e5f --region westeurope --skus Standard_ND40rs_v2:6 Standard_NC24s_v3:4 --type capacityReservation --priority production

az-support-bot: Support case created: SR#2109876543. Link: https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Support/CaseDetails/2109876543

sam: Copied. SR#2109876543 — I've added architecture diagrams and the expected window (2026-04-06 to 2026-06-06) and a contact (maya@redwood.ai).

leon: Quick Q: what's the expected monthly cost delta for reserving those ND40rs_v2? Need to CC finance if > $Xk/mo.

maya: Rough estimate ~€18k/month for 6 ND40rs_v2 reserved, but we'll confirm after Azure quote.

olivia: Also please request a temporary bump to networkInterfaces and vCPUs in westeurope: NICs +30, vCPU +200. We ran into NIC limits during the last scale test.

sam: Done — added NIC +30 and vCPU +200 to the SR.

raj: Can we ask them to reserve from the pool allocation rather than soft quota so it's actually capacity-reserved? Also please include a fallback region (eastus2) with quota-only for the same SKUs in case westeurope is constrained.

sam: Included fallback eastus2 as quota-only. Requested capacity reservation in westeurope with start date 2026-04-06.

az-support-bot: Azure support update (2026-03-31 09:12 UTC): Case SR#2109876543 assigned to support engineer Marta G. They've asked for a verification doc (cost owner & business justification).

maya: Uploading justification doc now.

sam: FYI here's a quick command to check current quota via CLI in case you want to validate locally:

sam: ```bash
# show current usage for region
az vm list-usage --location westeurope --output table
# list available SKUs for GPUs
az vm list-skus --location westeurope --size Standard_ND40rs_v2 --output table
```

leon: Thanks, I'll run those and post results.

leon: Ran az vm list-usage — NICs are at 82/100 in westeurope (so +30 will put us >100 unless they increase)

olivia: Yeah that's what I saw. Please emphasize NIC bump on the support case.

az-support-bot: Update from Azure (2026-04-01 16:03 UTC): Support requested subscription owner confirmation and a signed business justification PDF. Timeline estimate: 48-72h after docs submitted. Note: capacity reservations are subject to regional availability.

sam: Submitted signed justification and CC'd finance.

az-support-bot: Azure progress (2026-04-02 11:45 UTC): Engineer Marta G has performed quota checks. Preliminary: ND40rs_v2 availability limited; can provision up to 4 immediately, additional 2 are pending confirmation. NC24s_v3 capacity OK for 4. NIC and vCPU quota increases submitted to subscription team.

maya: Ok partial is fine — can we do 4 ND reserved and queue the other 2 as soon as capacity frees up?

sam: Asked Azure to reserve 4 ND40rs_v2 now and keep the other 2 on priority waitlist.

raj: Can we also request they apply the reservation to resources tagged redwood-prod and specify start date? Avoids accidental use by dev.

sam: Done — reservation tagged redwood-prod and start date specified.

az-support-bot: Update (2026-04-03 08:20 UTC): SR#2109876543 — Capacity reservation confirmed in westeurope for Standard_ND40rs_v2 x4 and Standard_NC24s_v3 x4. NIC quota increased by +30, vCPUs increased by +200. Remaining ND40rs_v2 x2 on waitlist. Estimated time to clear waitlist: 7-14 days depending on supply.

maya: Great news :party_parrot: Please record the confirmed numbers in the fleet planning doc.

sam: Recorded in infra runbook and pinged platform team.

leon: Cost ops — can you confirm if reservation billing starts on start date or at provisioning?

olivia: Azure usually bills reservation as soon as it's confirmed — check the reservation terms.

sam: I'll pull the reservation billing details and post.

sam: Quick note for runbook — if waitlist clears, automation will create the VMs under tag:redwood-prod in the reserved capacity pool; otherwise fallback eastus2 will be used.

az-support-bot: Final update (2026-04-06 14:55 UTC): SR#2109876543 closed by Azure. Reservation active: ND40rs_v2 x4 reserved, NC24s_v3 x4 reserved, NIC +30, vCPU +200. Waitlist: ND40rs_v2 x2 still pending. Case closed with reference PR#AZ-RES-1147.

maya: Thanks everyone. I'll schedule the first training job for 2026-04-08. :rocket:

sam: Closing out the Slack thread — leaving SR link in the infra runbook. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Ticket SR#2109876543 archived to /infra/support/sr-archive/2109876543.json
